div.div:
Purpose: Balance enterprise consistency with domain autonomy.
Applies to: Plan & Govern; Measure & Improve.
Lead / decisions: Council for enterprise policy; domain owner for delegated domain decisions.
Evidence: Delegation charter; domain map; decision register; escalation and exception records.

text.tspan: Purpose: Balance enterprise consistency with domain autonomy.
Applies to: Plan & Govern; Measure & Improve.
Lead / decisions: Council for enterprise policy; domain owner for delegated
domain decisions.
Evidence: Delegation charter; domain map; decision register; escalation and
exception records.

Applies to: All five stages.
Lead / decisions: Data owner, with council oversight and specialist advice where required.
Evidence: Critical-data register; risk rubric; tier-to-control mapping; prioritized remediation backlog.

Evidence: Versioned contract; consumer register; impact assessment; compatibility results; migration and rollback plan.

Evidence: Sharing register; due diligence; agreement; transfer controls; periodic review; termination and disposition evidence.

Applies to: All five stages.
Lead / decisions: Data owner for data permission and fitness, jointly coordinated with a named AI use-case owner.
Evidence: AI data-use register; provenance and permission records; dataset versions; fitness review; deletion-impact assessment.
